- **ONE session factory builds every agent runtime session, and bob never spawns pi or builds a pi command line for one.** Every agent runtime session — `bob run`, the persistent runtime, the launcher, the mail consumer, onboarding, alignment, and interactive `bob launch` — comes from a single factory in `src/shell/session.ts`, built on pi's runtime-factory contract, so every `/new`, `/resume`, `/fork`, `/clone` and `/import` goes through it too. The effective tool policy — the role's ceiling intersected with `bob.yaml`, minus `exclude` and the resident exclusions — is what a role-governed session is created with, and it is REQUIRED in the type and at runtime; onboarding and alignment are the one stated exception, on the fixed setup policy named below. `bob launch` takes AT MOST ONE PROMPT and nothing else: every other argument is refused BY NAME, so no caller-controlled argument reaches the session. `bob login` and `bob logout` (bob#241, under Added) are the exception: they start pi's own TUI as a separate process, with no arguments and an allowlisted environment, outside the factory and outside these controls, for the operator to sign in or out. (`test/shell/launch.test.ts`, `run-tool-allowlist.test.ts`)
